description: Convert between Simplified and Traditional Chinese
user_guide:
# Convert Chinese

Convert between Simplified and Traditional Chinese using OpenCC.

## Supported Modes
- **s2t**: Simplified to Traditional
- **t2s**: Traditional to Simplified
- **s2tw**: Simplified to Traditional (Taiwan Standard)
- **tw2s**: Traditional (Taiwan Standard) to Simplified
- **s2hk**: Simplified to Traditional (Hong Kong Standard)
- **hk2s**: Traditional (Hong Kong Standard) to Simplified
- **s2twp**: Simplified to Traditional (Taiwan Standard) with Phrases
- **tw2sp**: Traditional (Taiwan Standard) to Simplified with Phrases
